name: Bulbasaur
description: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth.

name: Ivysaur
description: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

name: Venusaur
description: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy.

name: Charmander
description: The flame on its tail shows the strength of its life force.

name: Charmeleon
description: When it swings its burning tail, the temperature around it rises.

name: Charizard
description: Its wings can carry it close to an altitude of 4,600 feet.

name: Squirtle
description: It withdraws into its shell when it feels threatened.

name: Wartortle
description: Its furry tail stores air for swimming underwater.

name: Blastoise
description: The water jets on its shell can accurately shoot targets from a great distance.

name: Caterpie
description: Its short feet have suction pads that enable it to climb slopes and walls.

name: Metapod
description: Its shell is soft immediately after it molts, but it soon hardens.

name: Butterfree
description: It loves to gather honey from flowers and carries it back to its nest.

name: Weedle
description: Its poison stinger is very dangerous. It uses its sharp horn to protect itself.

name: Kakuna
description: While waiting for evolution, it hides from predators by attaching itself to trees.

name: Beedrill
description: It has three poisonous stingers on its body and attacks with great speed.

name: Pidgey
description: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict, but it can become fierce when threatened.

name: Pidgeotto
description: It has outstanding vision and can spot prey from great distances.

name: Pidgeot
description: Its powerful wings allow it to fly at great speeds and create strong gusts of wind.

name: Rattata
description: Its incisors grow continuously, so it gnaws on hard objects to keep them sharp.

name: Raticate
description: Its sharp fangs can cut through nearly anything, and its whiskers help it keep its balance.

name: Spearow
description: It has a high-pitched cry and can be seen flying rapidly over grasslands.

name: Fearow
description: It has been around for many years and is recognized by its long beak and wings.

name: Ekans
description: The older it gets, the longer it grows. It can swallow prey whole.

name: Arbok
description: The patterns on its hood differ by region and are said to intimidate its enemies.

name: Pikachu
description: It can store electricity in its cheeks and release powerful electric shocks.

name: Raichu
description: Its long tail acts as a grounding point that protects it from its own electrical power.

name: Sandshrew
description: It burrows deep underground and curls into a ball when threatened.

name: Sandslash
description: Its claws and spikes allow it to climb trees and defend itself from attackers.

name: Nidoran♀
description: Although small, its venomous barbs make it dangerous. It uses its ears to sense danger.

name: Nidorina
description: It is cautious and usually avoids fighting, but its sharp claws can be used when necessary.

name: Nidoqueen
description: Its hard scales provide strong protection, and it uses its powerful body to defend its young.

name: Nidoran♂
description: It uses its large ears to check its surroundings and its poisonous horn to defend itself.

name: Nidorino
description: Its horn is harder than a diamond and can inject powerful venom into its opponents.

name: Nidoking
description: Its muscular body is covered with powerful scales, and its horn can inject a strong poison.

name: Clefairy
description: It is said to come from the moon and is often seen dancing under the light of a full moon.

name: Clefable
description: Its hearing is so sensitive that it can hear a pin drop from more than a kilometer away.

name: Vulpix
description: It is born with one white tail that splits into six tails as it grows.

name: Ninetales
description: It is said to live for a thousand years, and each of its nine tails has a special power.

name: Jigglypuff
description: Its soothing voice can lull listeners into a deep sleep.

name: Wigglytuff
description: Its body is soft and rubbery, allowing it to inflate itself by inhaling air.

name: Zubat
description: It emits ultrasonic waves to navigate through dark places because it cannot see.

name: Golbat
description: It attacks prey with its sharp fangs and drinks their blood.

name: Oddish
description: During the day it stays buried in the ground, absorbing nutrients from the soil.

name: Gloom
description: The fluid that drips from its mouth has a powerful and unpleasant smell.

name: Vileplume
description: Its large flower releases clouds of pollen that can cause strong allergic reactions.

name: Paras
description: Mushrooms grow on its back and draw nutrients from its host.

name: Parasect
description: The mushroom on its back has taken over its body and controls its movements.

name: Venonat
description: Its large eyes can detect tiny creatures even in darkness.

name: Venomoth
description: Its wings are covered in scales that can release poisonous powder when disturbed.

name: Diglett
description: It lives underground and leaves raised earth behind as it digs through the soil.

name: Dugtrio
description: Three Diglett work together as one unit, digging powerful tunnels through the ground.

name: Meowth
description: It loves shiny objects and often wanders at night looking for something to collect.

name: Persian
description: Its sleek body and sharp claws make it an agile and dangerous hunter.

name: Psyduck
description: It often suffers from headaches and sometimes unleashes mysterious psychic powers when the pain becomes severe.

name: Golduck
description: Its streamlined body allows it to swim extremely quickly through water.

name: Mankey
description: It becomes extremely angry over small things and can quickly lose control of its temper.

name: Primeape
description: It becomes so enraged that it will chase its target relentlessly until it finally calms down.

name: Growlithe
description: It is loyal and brave, often protecting its territory and trainer with great courage.

name: Arcanine
description: Its majestic appearance and powerful speed have made it famous in legends.

name: Poliwag
description: Its thin skin reveals the spiral-shaped organs inside its body.

name: Poliwhirl
description: Its smooth skin makes it difficult to grab, while the spiral pattern on its belly can mesmerize foes.

name: Poliwrath
description: Its powerful muscles allow it to swim great distances and fight with incredible strength.

name: Abra
description: It sleeps for most of the day and uses its psychic powers to teleport when threatened.

name: Kadabra
description: Its powerful psychic abilities cause strange events to happen around it.

name: Alakazam
description: Its incredible intelligence allows it to remember everything it experiences and solve complex problems.

name: Machop
description: It trains constantly to become stronger and can easily lift heavy objects despite its small size.

name: Machoke
description: Its muscular body is extremely powerful, so it wears a belt to help control its strength.

name: Machamp
description: With four powerful arms, it can deliver many punches at incredible speed.

name: Bellsprout
description: Its flexible body allows it to bend and sway, making it difficult for prey to escape.

name: Weepinbell
description: It catches prey with its vines and dissolves them using digestive fluids.

name: Victreebel
description: It attracts prey with a sweet scent before trapping them inside its large pitcher-shaped body.

name: Tentacool
description: It floats through the ocean and uses its poisonous tentacles to defend itself.

name: Tentacruel
description: Its many tentacles can stretch long distances and release powerful poison.

name: Geodude
description: It lives among rocks and often goes unnoticed because it looks like an ordinary stone.

name: Graveler
description: It rolls down mountainsides without stopping, crushing everything in its path.

name: Golem
description: Its rocky body is extremely durable, allowing it to survive powerful explosions.

name: Ponyta
description: Its fiery mane and tail become stronger as it grows, and it can run incredibly fast.

name: Rapidash
description: It races across open fields at incredible speeds, its mane blazing as it runs.

name: Slowpoke
description: It is very slow and often spends its days sitting beside rivers without noticing its surroundings.

name: Slowbro
description: A Shellder attached to its tail causes it to feel little pain and makes it unusually calm.

name: Magnemite
description: It floats using electromagnetic forces and attacks by releasing powerful electric energy.

name: Magneton
description: Three Magnemite join together to create a powerful magnetic force that can disrupt electronics.

name: Farfetch'd
description: It carries a leek like a weapon and uses it skillfully in battle.

name: Doduo
description: It has two heads that work together to keep watch while it runs across open ground.

name: Dodrio
description: Its three heads allow it to stay alert while running at very high speeds.

name: Seel
description: It prefers cold waters and uses its horn to break through thick ice.

name: Dewgong
description: Its thick body and layer of fat allow it to swim comfortably through freezing waters.

name: Grimer
description: It is made from polluted sludge and leaves a poisonous trail wherever it travels.

name: Muk
description: Its poisonous body is covered in toxic sludge that can damage anything it touches.

name: Shellder
description: Its hard shell protects its soft body, and it closes the shell tightly when threatened.

name: Cloyster
description: Its extremely hard shell protects it from almost any attack, while sharp spikes can launch from its body.

name: Gastly
description: Its body is made almost entirely of gas, allowing it to slip through walls and surround its opponents.

name: Haunter
description: It hides in darkness and can pass through solid objects while searching for unsuspecting prey.

name: Gengar
description: It hides in shadows and enjoys frightening people by appearing suddenly behind them.

name: Onix
description: It burrows through the ground at high speed, leaving behind long tunnels as it searches for food.

name: Drowzee
description: It feeds on dreams and can put people to sleep using its psychic abilities.

name: Hypno
description: It uses a pendulum to put people to sleep and can manipulate their dreams.

name: Krabby
description: It lives near beaches and uses its large pincers to defend itself and catch prey.

name: Kingler
description: Its enormous claw has tremendous crushing power, but its size makes it difficult to move.

name: Voltorb
description: It looks almost exactly like a Poké Ball and is known to suddenly explode when disturbed.

name: Electrode
description: It stores large amounts of electricity inside its body and can suddenly explode after absorbing power.

name: Exeggcute
description: Although it looks like a group of eggs, it is actually a collection of small living creatures working together.

name: Exeggutor
description: Each of its three heads can think independently, but they usually work together as one.

name: Cubone
description: It wears the skull of its deceased mother and carries a bone that it uses as a weapon.

name: Marowak
description: It has become a powerful fighter after learning to use bones as weapons and throwing them with great accuracy.

name: Hitmonlee
description: Its legs can stretch to incredible lengths, allowing it to deliver powerful kicks from a distance.

name: Hitmonchan
description: Its punches are incredibly fast and powerful, allowing it to strike opponents many times in a short moment.

name: Lickitung
description: Its long tongue is covered in sticky saliva and can reach objects several times its own body length.

name: Koffing
description: It floats in the air while releasing poisonous gases from its body when threatened.

name: Weezing
description: Two Koffing joined together to form this Pokémon, allowing it to produce an even stronger poisonous gas.

name: Rhyhorn
description: Its powerful body can charge through almost anything, but it has difficulty changing direction once it starts running.

name: Rhydon
description: Its thick hide protects it from extreme heat, and its powerful horn can destroy solid rock.

name: Chansey
description: It carries a nutritious egg that is highly valued because of its ability to restore energy.

name: Tangela
description: Its entire body is covered by thick blue vines that constantly grow and hide its appearance.

name: Kangaskhan
description: It raises its young inside a pouch and becomes extremely protective when its child is threatened.

name: Horsea
description: It lives among seaweed and can shoot powerful jets of water to defend itself.

name: Seadra
description: Its sharp spikes and poisonous body make it dangerous to approach, even though it looks calm.

name: Goldeen
description: Its elegant fins allow it to swim gracefully, but it can become aggressive when defending its territory.

name: Seaking
description: It uses its powerful horn to dig nests and protect its territory during the breeding season.

name: Staryu
description: Its central gem glows brightly at night, and it can regenerate lost parts of its body.

name: Starmie
description: Its mysterious core glows in many colors, especially when Starmie is swimming through the ocean at night.

name: Mr. Mime
description: It is skilled at creating invisible walls with its hands and uses mime-like movements to confuse others.

name: Scyther
description: Its sharp scythes allow it to cut through thick grass with incredible speed.

name: Jynx
description: Its movements resemble dancing, and it communicates through a language that sounds like human speech.

name: Electabuzz
description: It gathers around power plants and absorbs electricity while generating strong electrical sparks.

name: Magmar
description: Its body is constantly surrounded by flames, and it prefers to live near volcanic areas.

name: Pinsir
description: It uses its powerful pincers to grab opponents and can lift objects much heavier than itself.

name: Tauros
description: It becomes enraged when it starts charging and uses its three tails to whip its own body into a frenzy.

name: Magikarp
description: It is a weak swimmer that can barely move against strong currents, but it can eventually evolve into a powerful Pokémon.

name: Gyarados
description: Once it becomes enraged, it can destroy entire areas and rarely stops until everything around it is destroyed.

name: Lapras
description: It is gentle and intelligent, often carrying people across the ocean on its back.

name: Ditto
description: It can transform into almost any Pokémon by copying its opponent's appearance and abilities.

name: Eevee
description: Its unstable genetic structure allows it to evolve into several different forms depending on its environment.

name: Vaporeon
description: Its body has adapted to life in water, allowing it to become almost invisible when swimming.

name: Jolteon
description: Its fur can generate powerful static electricity, which it releases as sharp electric attacks.

name: Flareon
description: It stores inhaled air inside a flame sac and can release fire that reaches extremely high temperatures.

name: Porygon
description: It is a digital Pokémon created by scientists and is capable of moving through cyberspace.

name: Omanyte
description: This ancient Pokémon was restored from a fossil and uses its tentacles to move through the water.

name: Omastar
description: Its powerful tentacles can hold onto prey while its sharp teeth tear through their shells.

name: Kabuto
description: It is an ancient Pokémon restored from a fossil and was once believed to live in shallow seas.

name: Kabutops
description: Its sharp blades were used to cut through prey, and its streamlined body made it an excellent swimmer.

name: Aerodactyl
description: This ancient Pokémon had sharp teeth and powerful wings, allowing it to dominate the skies long ago.

name: Snorlax
description: It spends most of its time sleeping and wakes only when it becomes hungry enough to search for food.

name: Articuno
description: It is said to appear in snowy mountains and can freeze moisture in the air to create ice.

name: Zapdos
description: When it appears during a thunderstorm, it can generate powerful lightning and electricity with its wings.

name: Moltres
description: Its entire body is covered in brilliant flames, and legends say its appearance signals the arrival of spring.

name: Dratini
description: It was once thought to be a mythical Pokémon because it was rarely seen, but it grows steadily by shedding its skin.

name: Dragonair
description: It has a graceful body and can manipulate the weather, making rain or storms appear around it.

name: Dragonite
description: Despite its enormous size and power, it is known to be gentle and capable of rescuing people lost at sea.

name: Mewtwo
description: A Pokémon created through genetic manipulation, it possesses incredible psychic power and intelligence.

name: Mew
description: Mew is said to possess the genetic material of every Pokémon, allowing it to learn almost any move.
